params.body:
**Triage proposal** (from the forwarded mail; change the labels if it is wrong)
Category: bug  Priority: P2
Summary: The first real use of the report source list (Growing Up in Public, 18 lines) showed three faults: the check reads as a jumble, an example date reads as a real date, and a brand or app cited by its own site cannot be added at all.

Source: Portal mail:61, the first check on the live Studio after #83.

## What is wrong

- **The date field shows "2026-05-18" on every line without a date.** It is the example text of the field, and it reads as the page's date: an arXiv paper of 2023 and four unread pages all seemed dated 18 May 2026.
- **Every line carries its own status, coloured edge and three fields**, so eighteen lines read as eighteen small forms. What is ready, what needs a name and what cannot be used are mixed in paste order.
- **A front page is always refused.** Three of the report's sources are apps cited by their own site; the earlier reports hold such sources (two brands in Going to School in Phone-Free Europe). The writer has no way to say the site itself is the source.
- A read title keeps the site's name on its end ("... , Spotify"), and a page that names no publisher shows its host as publisher ("ec.europa.eu").

## Expected

- Checked lines in groups: ready (as they will be printed), to name (fields under one row of headings, no example text), not usable (with the reason), already in the list.
- A front page can be kept after the writer says the site itself is the source, and names it.
- Read titles without the site's name on the end; no host as publisher.

Needs a small change in the pipeline too (the hold accepts a site that is itself the source; titles tidied at the check).
params.title: Report source list: the check is hard to read, an example date reads as real, and a site cannot itself be the source
